requirements.name: Battery State Estimation
requirements.description: The system shall provide battery state estimation including SOC, SOE, SOF, and SOH calculations

requirements.name: Analog Front End Interface
requirements.description: The system shall interface with AFE devices for cell voltage and temperature measurement

requirements.name: Temperature Sensing
requirements.description: The system shall measure and monitor battery pack temperatures using various sensor types

requirements.name: System Configuration
requirements.description: The system shall provide configurable parameters for battery cell, system, and safety limits

requirements.name: System Basis Chip Control
requirements.description: The system shall control and monitor the System Basis Chip for power management and watchdog

requirements.name: BMS State Machine
requirements.description: The system shall implement a state machine for BMS operational modes and safety transitions

requirements.name: DRIVER Functions
requirements.description: The system shall provide driver functionality
